src: upper half s of the single two-color foreground object split at its horizontal midpoint
path: translate s right until its bottom-row leftmost foreground pixel is diagonally adjacent to the lower half's top-row rightmost foreground pixel
trajectory: place only the final translated upper-half sprite; leave no trail
dst: endpoint beside the fixed lower half
transform: exchange the two foreground colors in both halves; keep the lower half in place and clear the original upper-half cells
